title: Glimpses of Tomorrow
description: I will teach you to see forward, at three sites, one vision at a time. Acolytes who rush this come back unable to tell foresight from their own dread. I am protecting you from believing yourself too soon.

objectives.description: Meditate at the Elder Moor shrine
Meditate at the Thornfield sacred grove
Receive your first true prophetic vision

notes: Threat: the training itself, taken too fast, produces acolytes who mistake fear for foresight - the priest has seen it happen. Giver motive: pacing the visions is doctrinal caution, not ceremony for its own sake. Consequence: none wired; the priest's caution is characterization, not a fail state.
